---
title: Roles and affiliation positions
subtitle: Read straight from the author metadata Quarto already builds
date: 2026-08-15
author:
  - name: Ada Lovelace
    roles:
      - original author
      - writing: lead
    affiliation:
      - name: Analytical Engine Institute
        position: Head of Research
        url: https://example.org/aei
  - name: Luigi Menabrea
    roles:
      - translator
      - formal analysis: supporting
    affiliation:
      - name: Turin Academy
        position: Lecturer
---

The title block above adds a roles column and an affiliation position.
No change to Quarto is needed, and no Lua filter is used.

Both come from the author metadata that `authors.lua` already normalises.

- `roles:` becomes `by-author[].roles[]`, with `role` and `degree-of-contribution`.
- `position:` is not a known affiliation field, so it is kept under `by-author[].affiliations[].metadata.position`.

`formal analysis` is a CRediT term, so Quarto also attaches the vocabulary data to it.
The partial in this example does not print that data, but it is available.
